managementNarrative: As Systems Engineering Manager 3 in Boulder, led a geographically distributed OPIR ground-processing systems engineering section of approximately 50 engineers across four managers. The role emphasized recruiting, performance management, promotions, skills development and building trust across sites. Traveled frequently to Azusa, where the director and senior director worked, and visited Northrop Grumman's Space Park and Dayton campuses. A Dayton-based manager and several team members supported NASIC at Wright-Patterson AFB; personal travel to that base is not confirmed. Developed a broader understanding of OPIR technology while supporting major space-program capture efforts, technical-volume and basis-of-estimate work, and color-team reviews. Participated in Space Sector intellectual-property activities and technical communities. Also supported RGS-A from RF capture-volume authorship through SEIT leadership.
